logreg.notes: StandardScaler + L2 logistic regression, class_weight=balanced, lbfgs

gnb.notes: Gaussian Naive Bayes, class priors from data, no scaling needed

knn.notes: StandardScaler + KNN (euclidean), trained on a capped row sample

rf.notes: Random forest, class_weight=balanced_subsample, n_jobs=-1; max_leaf_nodes bounds tree size so the deployed model stays small (an unbounded forest on 1.3M rows grows to GBs)

svm_rbf.notes: StandardScaler + RBF SVC, Platt (sigmoid) calibration with 3-fold CV, class_weight=balanced, capped rows; gamma = 1/n_features, equivalent to sklearn's 'scale' on standardised features
